styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium dark-tech mobile accessory visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep space navy-black #0A0E1F, clean white #FFFFFF, misty blue-grey #D8DFE7 and one magenta accent #C0286E, with white text #FFFFFF on dark panels and charcoal text #2D2D2D on light panels; neutral-cool studio lighting with a soft rim light tracing the curved screen edges and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif bold headlines; consistent rounded pill badges and circular thin-line icon badges; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; the phone screen always shows a neutral abstract wallpaper with no real interface; stable product scale and placement; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
